result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would erase the idea that any human life is more valuable than another. Not just in words, but in the systems, histories, and daily choices that treat some lives as disposable—whether through war, poverty, racism, nationalism, or indifference.

Every other injustice stems from this belief. Poverty, violence, exploitation—they all flourish where one group decides their well-being matters more. So I’d dismantle the hierarchies of worth, not with another grand plan, but by making people question, *What if your life, truly, is not more important than mine?* And then live like the answer changes everything.
